line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Fresh x86 compile controls with actual headers; external ABI evidence only.

decision: R1303: retain APIENTRY for the exported WOW32ResolveMemory declaration. Product /Gz already defaults to stdcall, but public WOW multimedia extension consumers compiling with /Gd otherwise see a cdecl function. Restoring the original header breaks binding to the exported callback type in this supported context.
